pages.name: Herald of Death
pages.text: The one who comes when life draws to an end.

pages.title: The summoning
pages.text: He does not appear on his own. He can be called only by a special ritual: combine the three Herald hearts into a $(item)Proof of Strength$() and right-click the $(item)Echo of the Beyond$() block with it.

pages.title: Proof of Strength
pages.text: The recipe needs the Hearts of Storm, Hunger and Cold.

pages.title: Advice
pages.text: Little is known about this Herald, so do not draw hasty conclusions.$(br2)$(li)Arrive fully geared, with food and a $(item)Fern Pearl$().$(li)Check your ability bar: this is no ordinary fight.$(li)If you lose, the Herald vanishes without a heart.

pages.title: Reward
pages.text: Victory leaves a $(item)Heart of Death$(). Absorbing it grants the ability “Energy of the Beyond”.
